mentions.note: performed on the radio in Merry-Go-Round; walked to help the Club win the wartime Surrey County Road-Walking title; stationed in Lincs
performed at the Pavilion, Bognor Regis
"The Banjulele Boy"; won the 1929 Boxing Day Walk Handicap

photos.c: Charlie Redgrave, "The Banjulele Boy", passes Alf Harley only feet from the tape to win the 1929 Boxing Day Walk Handicap.
